def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform divider and extract the equal-sized panels on either side.
    divider_row = next(
        (r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1), None
    )
    if divider_row is not None:
        top = grid[:divider_row]
        bottom = grid[divider_row + 1:]
        n = min(len(top), len(bottom))
        a, b = top[-n:], bottom[:n]
        shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
        background = next(iter(shared), 0)
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else background
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(n)]

    divider_col = next(c for c in range(w)
                       if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [row[:divider_col] for row in grid]
    right = [row[divider_col + 1:] for row in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    a = [row[-n:] for row in left]
    b = [row[:n] for row in right]
    shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    background = next(iter(shared), 0)
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else background

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find a unique uniform divider line, ignoring uniform background rows.
    row_candidates = []
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            color = row[0]
            if sum(1 for rr in grid if len(set(rr)) == 1 and rr[0] == color) == 1:
                row_candidates.append(r)

    if row_candidates:
        r = row_candidates[0]
        upper, lower = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        from collections import Counter
        upper_bg = Counter(v for row in upper for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        lower_bg = Counter(v for row in lower for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
        return [[upper_bg if v == lower_bg else 3 for v in row] for row in lower]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter

    # A uniform horizontal divider separates the example pattern from the
    # pattern to recolor.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1:
            upper = grid[:r]
            lower = grid[r + 1:]
            upper_bg = Counter(v for rr in upper for v in rr).most_common(1)[0][0]
            lower_bg = Counter(v for rr in lower for v in rr).most_common(1)[0][0]
            return [[upper_bg if v == lower_bg else 3 for v in rr]
                    for rr in lower]

    # Vertical divider: compare corresponding cells of the two panels.
    c = next(i for i in range(w)
             if len({grid[rr][i] for rr in range(h)}) == 1)
    left = [rr[:c] for rr in grid]
    right = [rr[c + 1:] for rr in grid]
    n = min(len(left[0]), len(right[0]))
    left = [rr[-n:] for rr in left]
    right = [rr[:n] for rr in right]

    lb = Counter(v for rr in left for v in rr).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rb = Counter(v for rr in right for v in rr).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg = lb if lb == rb else grid[0][c]
    return [[3 if left[rr][cc] == right[rr][cc] else bg
             for cc in range(n)] for rr in range(h)]
